scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/api & npm run dev -w apps/web & npm run dev -w apps/crm
scripts.build: npm run prepare:api-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/crm
scripts.lint: npm run prepare:api-types && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/crm
scripts.test: npm run prepare:api-types && npm run test -w apps/api
